description:
Find which Microburbs tool answers a question, in plain words —
e.g. "how many people rent in Bondi", "is this house in a flood zone",
"schools near 10 Smith St". Typo-tolerant, knows synonyms. Returns the
best tools first, each with its MCP tool name, REST path, price in
cents and a description. Free.
name: search_endpoints
title: Search endpoints
